officialText:
As a condition of license renewal, a licensed master fire suppression piping contractor shall provide evidence satisfactory to the department that such licensee is fit to perform the work.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.

Article 411: Journeyman Fire Suppression Piping Installer Registration
